title: Private Grand Canyon West + Hoover Dam Photo Stop (1-Day)
includes: Pick-up and drop off from select hotels
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Collapsible wheelchairs and strollers are only permitted.
policies: We do allow for regular sized backpacks that can fit underneath your seats. NO suitcases, or luggage is permitted.
Please note an alternative vehicle may be assigned (SUV/sprinter) based off tour group size.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the ultimate Grand Canyon West Rim tour with VIP service, luxurious comfort, and breathtaking photo opportunities. Ride in style aboard a Mercedes Sprinter van with spacious seating, tinted windows, climate control, USB ports, and onboard Wi-Fi as expert guides share fascinating stories and insider tips. Discover world-famous landmarks, capture stunning Grand Canyon views, and make a memorable stop at the iconic Hoover Dam on your return to Las Vegas. This small-group adventure combines comfort, scenery, and unforgettable experiences into one perfect day.
